Against tier0_v13_pfffree on PFF-B: bridged m0 +0.0119 [+0.0048, +0.0191] and m2 +0.0093 [+0.0023, +0.0163]; native m0 -0.0042 [-0.0102, +0.0017] and m2 -0.0115 [-0.0181, -0.0048]. Synthetic seeds 15-24: worst-group margin over baseline_smooth50 0.1682 against tier0_v18 0.1568 and tier0_v13_pfffree 0.1038; above tier0_v18 in 5 of the 6 IDSSE groups (the sixth -0.0001) and below it in all 9 Metrica groups by 0.013 to 0.032. Above baseline_smooth50 in every group and on all 64 PFF games.
provenance.fitted: q_logit: E5's logistic of P(token == labelled team) on alive frames after kickoff of IDSSE and Metrica m0 (probes._newton), with E60 goalward-ball term. spell_logit: E30's flip-helps target and features without seen, touch_own, touch_other, rel_own, shape_own, held_own, a ridge-1 Newton logistic over 7993 candidate runs with token share 0.5 or more on IDSSE m0 and Metrica m0 renewal worlds at dead_bias 2.6, seeds 0-4, decoded by tier0_v10 with the new q_logit; weights rounded to 4 places. No PFF or StatsBomb file is read.
provenance.inherited_selection: Every other value is tier0_v15's and was selected by ranking on PFF-A labels under rule v2 (see params/tier0_v15.json provenance.selection). This file removes PFF-fitted weights, not PFF-informed selection.
provenance.public_window: Inherited from tier0_v15 unchanged; this refit never read the public window. The hillclimb changed only dead_min_run, dead_trim, dead_close, dead_line_m, dead_line_min_run, dead_line_lead_cut, dead_lead_cut, dead_out_lead_cut, dead_outside_m, dead_still_mps, dead_still_frames, dead_pace_still_mps, handover_lag, spell_flip_p, spell_flip_frames, spell_flip_seen, spell_logit, switch_penalty, spell_push_mps, spell_push_frames, spell_push_unseen and the emission's q_logit_a, q_logit_dist and q_logit_margin. It scored files on the public window as a correctness check, never inside a selection rule: tier0_v2, tier0_v7 and tier0_v0 at 09:32 and 09:36 IST on 2026-10-24, and tier0_v8 at 11:40 IST. Every experiment from E17 on, selection rules v3 and v4, spell_merge_frames, the spell_push fields, switch_penalty and the spell_flip, dead_lead and dead_line fields came after the first read. Inherited from tier0_v1: Selection read only the Metrica dev worlds in sweep_worlds. The marginal temper grid {0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2} was set from a public-window smoke test that put temper's useful range at 0.01 to 0.1. The m2 worlds merge Metrica spells under 2 s because raw Metrica spells are much shorter than the public window's, though 2 s was not fitted to the window. The decoder dead_bias 1.0 was selected from a {1, 3} axis whose 1.0 is the flat default, argued partly from a public-window count. These choices were committed on 2026-10-21. EVALUATION.md had said since 2026-09-24 to use the window to check correctness and never to choose between two versions. Upstream f8f2629 (2026-10-23) made RULES.md say the window is not training data and not a tuning set. v1 won this sweep on dev but was set aside the same day, on CHALLENGE.md and public-window figures (23 predicted possessions against 17, spellF1 0.310 against 0.412). On controlled-possession dev worlds it later lost to v0 at 5 s (-0.026 spellF1) and tied at 3 s. This public_window text was added by hand on 2026-10-24, and the command above does not write it. See possession/DESIGN.md, Measurements and constant provenance.
